creator: nocode.joshua
title: Second-hand report that Boris Cherny (Claude Code creator) recommends deleting your CLAUDE.md files and skills every six months because they were written for older models

tools.name: Claude Opus 5
tools.detail: release the talk was about, per creator

claims: Boris Cherny (on-screen: 'Head of Claude Code, Anthropic') said at a conference around the Opus 5 release that he recommends deleting all CLAUDE.md files and skills every six months
Reason given: instructions were written for models that no longer exist; newer models need much less context/instruction
Creator says it is 'day 411' of his series (on-screen card says 'Day 11')
how_to_steps: Every ~6 months, delete (or at least re-audit) CLAUDE.md files and skills
Re-create only the instructions the current model actually still needs
on_screen_only: Title card: 'You Need to DELETE your Claude skills and Claude.md file'
Card: 'Day 11 of Breaking down AI for You'
Lower-third on conference clip: 'Boris Cherny - Head of Claude Code, Anthropic'

relevance.why: Haji has a large skill library and many CLAUDE.md/rule files; stale model-era rules (NEVER lists, workarounds for old failure modes) are real context bloat. But wholesale deletion would destroy business-specific knowledge (email voice, council gate, handoff formats).

implement_score.why: Do a periodic audit, not a purge: diff each skill/CLAUDE.md for rules that compensate for old model behavior and remove them; keep domain knowledge. A half-day calendar task every model generation.

gap.what: Adds a cadence heuristic (re-set instruction files every ~6 months / each model generation) on top of the already-liked 'Anthropic cut 80% of the system prompt, keep CLAUDE.md thin' video. Mostly a reframing; the quote is second-hand.

verify: Find the actual Boris Cherny talk/clip; did he say 'delete' or 'review'?
Is 'Opus 5' the correct model name for the release he references?
Day count inconsistency (411 vs 11) suggests sloppy reporting
